content.document_title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure - Task Force Members
content.declaration_scope: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration conducted every January covering the previous calendar year. Calls for declaration conducted during development of these guidelines up to and including 2020.

financial_declaration.summary: Payments from healthcare industry or bodies for personal services (speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member).

items.detail: £150 honoraria for attending guideline meetings over past 12 years as a patient representative.

items.destination: Passed directly to Cardiomyopathy UK charity, 2019. No future meetings envisaged.

other_positions_of_influence.summary: Memberships/affiliations in political or advocacy groups working in cardiology; patient representative roles.
items: Makes monthly payments by bank standing order to Cardiomyopathy UK, a British charity supporting people with cardiomyopathy and myocarditis.
Sits on the Patient Advisory Group of Brompton Hospital, London, advising on applicability of research applications.
Patient representative on the English & Welsh National Heart Failure Audit.
Patient representative on the IRONMAN trial investigating use of IV iron in people with heart failure.
Contributor to a paper on patient experiences in a heart failure research trial (yet to be published/presented).

declarations.other_interests: Holds shares inside and outside of a pension managed by a portfolio manager; unaware of specific holdings and therefore does not know whether any shares are in healthcare or healthcare-related companies, or in media or education companies.

financial_declaration.summary: Payments from healthcare industry or bodies for personal services (speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member).

items.destination: Passed in full to UK charity, Cardiomyopathy UK. There will be no more honoraria.
